title: B2B Sales Closer
description: We are looking for a ruthless B2B closer who understands the value of high-ticket engineering. No base salary ceiling. You hunt enterprise deals, you close them, and you take home an aggressive percentage of the revenue.

title: Agentic AI Developer (Intern)
